name: print-social-lilac-health-and-care-post-set-with-doctor-cutouts-and-swoosh
title: Lilac Health and Care Post Set with Doctor Cut-Outs
whatItIs: A stock preview of a lilac health-care post set on a periwinkle band: a post with a bearded doctor cut out beside a rotated 'dr. lorum' label and a lilac headline card, a centre post with a white card 'HEALTH & CARE' on a swoosh background and a post with a woman doctor beside a stethoscope icon tile and a text card.
whatItMeans: A curving lilac ribbon and cut-out professionals feel trustworthy, and rotated name labels add a small design flourish.
techniques: Rotated name tag along the edge of the photo
Icon tile as a secondary graphic

vocabulary.definition: A person masked from a photo and placed over shapes.
A label turned 90 degrees along a photo edge.
A curved band used as a background graphic.
